Bone Tender

You prepared the dead with care; eventually some seemed reluctant to leave your company.

Who taught you that respect and fear are different things?

Rules

Choose one:

- Calling 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.3c796e5661abc3c2.JournalEntryPage.44e2c6da9c37f071]{Summon Undead — Novice}. - Life 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.093976403a974e80.JournalEntryPage.b3f5d46a176d7066]{Keep the Door Closed}.

Type: Background

Each option is a pair. Duplicate grants give 1 level-0 DP each; no automatic higher rank. Follow the card’s equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
